Keep either Feature or Bug fix and delete the other section.
For maintenance or docs, replace both with a short Summary explaining what and why.
Keep it brief: explain the behavior and decisions, not the list of changed files.
Link a related issue or design document when useful. State uncertainty directly.
Delete guidance comments when done.
-->

## How

<!--
Describe the change and why this approach solves the problem.
Call out breaking changes, compatibility effects, or required user actions when applicable.
-->

## Alternatives considered

<!--
Which alternatives did you consider, and why choose this approach? Include meaningful tradeoffs.
Only describe options actually considered. If none, say so briefly.
-->

## Verification

<!--
Report checks actually run: commands or manual steps, relevant environment, and observed results.
For bug fixes, show that the reproduction or regression test fails before and passes after;
if you could not check both, say which you verified.
Separate untested behavior, limitations, and proposed checks from completed checks.
For docs-only changes, formatting and a content review can be enough.
-->

Optional: add a Visuals section when a diagram, graphic, or interactive artifact
